releases.notes:
**Minecraft 26.2** is now supported. This build needs Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, and Fabric API for 26.2. Menus and HUDs need the OpenGL graphics backend. 26.1.2 no longer gets updates, so stay on v1.4.3 if you play that version.

**Commission Count** is a new HUD that shows your commission total on screen, in the same font as the Pickaxe Cooldown HUD:
- **Show Session** adds a second line with this session's count.
- **Number Only**, **Text Align**, **Label Color**, **Value Color** and **Hide with F1** let you style it.
- It replaces **Stats in Menu**, so the count no longer appears inside the commissions menus.

**Ordered waypoints**
- Routes now save in SkyHanni's format, so the same file opens in either mod.
- `/mqo convert` rewrites old `.txt` routes and moves the originals to `txt-backup/`. Old routes still load if you don't convert them.
- `/mqo export` copies a route in SkyHanni's format, ready for `/shordered import`. `/mqo export text` copies the old format.
- **Block Outline** has new settings: **Outline Color**, **Outline Radius**, **Visible Edges Only** and **Outline Current Waypoint**.

Includes cheat and legit Fabric builds for Minecraft 26.2.

releases.notes:
**Commission Stats** is now its own module:
- **Current Comms**: type how many commissions you've done, and every completion adds to it (`/commtrack set <number>` also works).
- **Stats HUD**: the on-screen Total / Comms/hr / Session panel, now a separate toggle.
- **Stats in Menu**: shows "Total | Session" above the commissions menu, on both Hypixel's menu and the custom Comm Menu GUI. You can move it in the HUD editor, and **Reset Menu Line** puts it back above the menu.

If you had the stats HUD on before, it stays on.

**Comm Claim** (cheat) is back to how it worked in 1.4.1. The loadout tracking and "No Swap In Shaft" from 1.4.2 are removed.

Includes cheat and legit Fabric builds for Minecraft 26.1.2.

releases.notes:
**CoalClick**
- Fires when the ability is actually back, timed off the interpolated pickaxe cooldown, so it no longer goes a second late (or early).
- Never fires while a menu or chat is open; an activation interrupted by a menu is cancelled and retried once it closes.
- A missed activation is retried after 1.5s instead of 5s, and the second drill is clicked sooner.

**Comm Claim** (cheat)
- Tracks which loadout you have on: no swap if you're already wearing the claim loadout, and it swaps back to whatever you were wearing.
- New **No Swap In Shaft** toggle: claim inside a mineshaft without any loadout swap.

**Auto Party**
- Corpses are now detected correctly, so corpse sign-ups get warped.
- The warp waits for everyone invited to join (up to the disband timeout, or until an invite expires) instead of warping on the first join.

**HUDs**
- Rolling Miner has the same options as Pickaxe Cooldown: Hide with F1, Text Align, Seconds Suffix, Cooldown Only, Cooldown Seconds and Ready Title.
- Commission Stats: enter your lifetime commission count in **Current Comms** (or `/commtrack set <number>`) and the total counts up from there. It also shows above the Comm Menu GUI.

Includes cheat and legit Fabric builds for Minecraft 26.1.2.

releases.notes:
Supports Minecraft 1.21.10, 1.21.11, and 26.1.2 (cheat + legit jars for each).

## Changes
- **Comm Claim: wardrobe → loadout.** Hypixel moved armor-set swapping to `/loadout`; claiming now opens the loadout GUI and clicks the 12-slot (3x4) grid. Loadout selectors are now 1-12.
- **Comm Claim: new "Batch Mining" toggle.**
  - **ALL** (default): waits until every mining commission is done before claiming (won't interrupt a grind partway).
  - **EACH**: claims as soon as any commission is done.

## Downloads
Pick your Minecraft version and edition:
- `miningqol-1.3.1-<mcversion>-cheat.jar`
- `miningqol-1.3.1-<mcversion>-legit.jar`

## Changes

releases.notes:
## Block Profit Tracker Fix

- Fixed profit calculation to properly parse sack messages
- Now correctly handles multiple items per sack message
- Combines raw + enchanted items before calculating rate
- Uses time from sack messages (Last Xs.) for accurate rate calculation
- Removed inventory tracking - now only uses sack messages
- Fixed time tracking bug (was adding 2min instead of 30s)
- Added /trackerdebug command for debugging
